        """Stack variables of a Dataset into a single DataArray.

            missing_dims = set(sample_dims) - set(var.dims)
            if missing_dims:

                var = var.broadcast_like(self[list(sample_dims)[0]])

        result = DataArray.concat(variables, dim=new_dim)

            [list(self.data_vars.keys()), result.coords[new_dim].values],
            names=["variable"] + [new_dim],

            result.name = name
